name: None
prompt: Use no ad-libs; keep every vocal line clean and uninterrupted.

name: Sparse Accent Ad-Libs
prompt: Add only a few short parenthetical accents at major punches and transitions.

name: Frequent Hype Ad-Libs
prompt: Use frequent concise hype responses, echoes, and crew accents in parentheses without crowding the lead.

name: Callout Layers
prompt: Layer repeated callouts, answer phrases, and left-right vocal responses around key lines.

name: Atmospheric Vocal Textures
prompt: Use breath sounds, hums, whispers, and wordless vocal layers as atmosphere rather than hype.

name: Completely Dry
prompt: Use only the lead lyric with no parenthetical phrases echoes crowd replies hums or extra vocal layers.

name: Whispered Echoes
prompt: Place a few quiet whispered repeats after emotionally important words and at section transitions.

name: Crew Responses
prompt: Add short group replies behind key boasts hook lines and final words without covering the lead.

name: Call-and-Response
prompt: Leave rhythmic gaps for a second voice or crowd to answer selected lead phrases with concise replies.

name: Comedic Reactions
prompt: Add brief surprised sarcastic or exaggerated reactions that sharpen jokes without becoming a second lyric.

name: Rage Shouts
prompt: Use short explosive shouted words breaths and crowd bursts mainly around drops hooks and breakdowns.

name: Gospel Responses
prompt: Add supportive choir answers affirmations and rising held responses around testimony-like lead lines.

name: Dancehall Hype
prompt: Use rhythmic selector-style callouts rewinds and crowd prompts sparingly around transitions and hook returns.

name: Producer-Tag Style
prompt: Use one short original signature-style vocal tag at the opening or a major transition; never copy a real producer tag.

name: Ambient Vocal Textures
prompt: Use wordless hums breaths distant vowel layers and reversed whispers as atmosphere rather than lyrical replies.
